styleLock.lockText: consistent industrial-tool e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy #2F4470, slate blue #5A6A9E, clean white #FFFFFF, with one safety-orange accent #F07800 matching the product; cool-toned studio lighting; modern geometric sans-serif headlines wrapped in 「」; consistent rounded rectangular info cards and label chips; consistent thin-line geometric icons; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement on matte pedestal blocks with clean balanced framing; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 9 张详情页长图切片提炼；已剥离源图品牌字样、会员/二维码角标与全部在图文案（含规格表中的品牌与乱写规格），统一改由文案槽位承载。panel-03 与 panel-07 的源图区域缺失，仅沿用其版式语法，不复制内容。L1=家装灯具、L2=五金工具（taxonomy 实际条目，卷尺属测量工具），与源文件夹名「五金」语义相近但不逐字一致，故取更精确的 五金工具。
